title: Shape
body: Elongin, Girthin, and Crescentin work in the cytosol and take no position. Elongin stretches the cell, Girthin widens it, and Crescentin bends it. The amount you express is how far that change goes.

Taperin also stays in the cytosol, and it does take a position. Copies gathered at a site pinch that end, in proportion to their expression. Crystallin and Isoprene Synthase have to be secreted. Any of either one changes the envelope, and stronger expression lays the layer on thicker.
